text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One day, heavy rain necessitates we
cancel our outdoor training. I'm
spending
time in my office to put together an indoor
training plan.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I've noticed that I've been losing items
much more often lately.
Yesterday I
misplaced some paperwork from the
academy, and today
it appears I've lost my
pen.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I stand up from my desk to go fetch a new
one, when—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Bump!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Though I'm alone in my office, I feel as if
someone has collided with
me, and I
stumble forward.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
That won't do. How am I supposed to be
an effective trainer if I'm just
bumbling
around? I slap myself on the cheek and
proceed.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Pant, pant, pant...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Phew... Um... trainer? The music...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I notice that the music we were using for
our shuttle runs has stopped.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Hey... Have you, um...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: No... That's not it.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Have you noticed... anything strange
recently?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: If not... good.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Maybe you should call it a day here?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Okay... In that case, I'll be sticking around
a little longer.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
You don't... need to do that. Please go
home and rest...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
No detours... Go straight home... And
also...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
You shouldn't come to the training course
at night... At least for a
little while...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: You mustn't visit me... at night...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I walk outside to find that the rain has
stopped. I head home while
pondering
what she just told me.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Maybe she's upset with me for all the
careless mistakes I made today.
I begin to
think of ways to avoid making the same
blunders tomorrow,
when...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I'm chilled to my very core. It's as if
someone is glaring at me from
behind...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I turn quickly to find no one there. I still
feel some kind of presence
directly behind
me!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: I forgot... to tell you something.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: I'm sorry... That wasn't my intention.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: I just wanted to tell you to be careful...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: So with that said...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
I knew it... Instead of me, it looks like it's
targeting Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Is it... displeased? Or could it be...
